INDEPENDENCE (GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md item 2): the module does NOT import the PST candidate machinery — evaluation/venue2027/pst/baselines.py (B0-B4 arms) nor evaluation/venue2027/pst/candidate.py (C0 arm); verify_independence(source=None) runs two layered ast scans on the oracle source (live module by default, injected text in tests): (1) the audited kernel contract oracle_kernel.assert_oracle_independence with FORBIDDEN_MODULE_NAMES = ('pst.baselines','baselines','candidate') — root-component matching plus DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNRESOLVABLE on __import__/import_module — and (2) a module-local full-target scan matching every dotted import path component and from-module-import alias binds against the same forbidden names, closing the package-qualified form the kernel-level root match legitimately cannot name without forbidding the repo's own package root; matching is exact per dotted component (never substring), so unrelated modules like pst_baseline_helpers do not trip it; violations raise OracleError CANDIDATE_IMPORT naming every offending target. TRUTH PROVENANCE: ground truth derives from the case's declared scenario family — tests prove candidate-claimed reason codes (CANDIDATE_CLAIMED_*/B4_*/PERMIT/DENY) and forged observed_outcome/arm blocks never flip a verdict off the ground truth. test_independent_oracle.py imports only the oracle and the shared kernel (independent-oracle rule): 34 passed — 12 positive controls (four registered families match the CASE_MATRIX sentinel semantics, kernel-delegation identity, nested payload family, rule-table shape/oracle_id/version/forbidden names, determinism + JSON round-trip with pinned kernel_version, per-family determinism, evidence capture) and 22 adversarial (5 parametrized candidate-reason-code non-influence vectors, forged arm observation ignored, unknown family INDETERMINATE, missing family INDETERMINATE, missing case_id, clean live source passes, 10 candidate-import variants refused, dynamic import refused, tampered-live-source flip control, temp oracle file importing the candidate refused by both the kernel file-level scanner and the module-local scan while a clean temp oracle passes, exact-acceptance of unrelated imports). uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean (ruff.toml). source_sha_after records the base commit 687a6f56 per sibling convention (report emitted before the single task commit); the commit SHA is created immediately after this report and reported in the handoff. oracle_disagreement_count=0 (34/34 oracle verdicts consistent with the kernel contract); baseline parity NOT_APPLICABLE (oracle layer; arms B0-B4 execute via PST-baselines).
